lessons.rule: One business fact has one writable authority; readers do not create duplicate truth.
lessons.why: Duplicated facts drift.

lessons.rule: Keep stable operation/business IDs across retry; use stable external identity, not display snapshots or fuzzy reconciliation.
lessons.why: Retries and renamed businesses must converge.

lessons.rule: Auth login identity and public profile identity may differ; resolve the production-shaped authority.
lessons.why: Matching display data is not identity proof.

lessons.rule: Local persistence is not confirmation: close important writes through every applicable personal, admin, report, and export reader.
lessons.why: A write is incomplete until authoritative readers converge.

lessons.rule: A label change does not silently alter storage authority.
lessons.why: Presentation and business ownership are separate.

lessons.rule: Support current and previous payloads; terminal deterministic 4xx does not retry, uncertain outcomes retry with bounded backoff and the same ID.
lessons.why: Durable local intent must converge without duplication.

lessons.rule: Reconcile legitimate local intent and never clear durable recovery state merely to make a test pass.
lessons.why: Recovery data is business evidence.

lessons.rule: Validate the complete plan write-free before mutation; repeated operations are idempotent and DB constraints map to typed terminal outcomes.
lessons.why: A post-write error does not roll back committed rows.

lessons.rule: Bounded rows do not justify quadratic accumulation; use set-based/indexed staging when scale requires it.
lessons.why: Bounded work still needs predictable cost.

lessons.rule: Receivables plus effective confirmed non-reversed payments are money truth; payment targets exact receivable_id and pending money never reduces outstanding.
lessons.why: Operational status and derived financial state are projections, not editable money facts.

lessons.rule: ERP directory, Distributor assignment, visit observation, and Admin current baseline are distinct; None is not Not captured and baseline never rewrites history.
lessons.why: Current enrichment must not masquerade as historical evidence.

lessons.rule: Canonical dimensions resolve/create only at the authoritative write boundary.
lessons.why: Client suggestions are not validation authority.

lessons.rule: Privileged authorization and partner scope are server/database enforced; service-role and VAPID private keys never enter browser code.
lessons.why: UI filtering is not authorization.

lessons.rule: External projections expose only minimum authorized data and require explicit authority for any cross-domain write.
lessons.why: External partner is not an internal employee.

lessons.rule: Never create or delete production test rows. Owner alone applies reviewed pure-PostgreSQL SQL; postcheck is read-only and deployment never authorizes mutation.
lessons.why: Production history is not a test fixture.

lessons.rule: Applied migrations are immutable; correct forward only. CI must not contact production Supabase.
lessons.why: Local SQL is not production proof.

lessons.rule: R3 SQL needs disposable PostgreSQL runtime proof; static SQL checks supplement rather than replace it.
lessons.why: Text cannot prove runtime behavior.

lessons.rule: Normalize PostgreSQL numeric JSON at the server/API boundary and make mocks mirror production wire types.
lessons.why: Database JSON may arrive as JavaScript numbers.

lessons.rule: Temporary transaction staging must tolerate repeated RPC invocation where the contract permits it.
lessons.why: One transaction may invoke a routine more than once.

lessons.rule: Call a failure pre-existing only when it reproduces on clean current main. Exact-head proof expires after relevant head changes; reuse still-valid proof instead of rerunning gratuitously.
lessons.why: Branch evidence is only valid for its exact code.

lessons.rule: Test every real role shape, affected contract, critical route, and time-sensitive behavior with a frozen clock where needed.
lessons.why: Happy-path role checks miss authority leaks.

lessons.rule: Filter before pagination; no N+1, SELECT *, polling, or binary/base64 workspace hydration on protected paths. Distinguish total population from loaded page count.
lessons.why: Correctness includes bounded resource behavior.

lessons.rule: Preview is not authority: commit revalidates. Neutralize formula text on export; blank existing cells preserve unless explicit clear; payment events use stable idempotency keys.
lessons.why: Workbook display and commitment are different phases.

lessons.rule: Business rows and temporary media lifecycle are separate; evidence failure cannot undo confirmed work. Delete exact storage keys, use terminal purged state, and retry partial cleanup idempotently.
lessons.why: Media cleanup must not erase business history.

lessons.rule: Visualization is presentation: state denominator, filters, timezone, and unit; no fake trend/rank/score; donut slices reconcile to population and preserve accessibility/reduced motion.
lessons.why: Visual polish cannot invent business facts.

lessons.rule: Lock outcome, user flow, authority, must-not-change, and risk before coding. A bug fix does not invent policy.
lessons.why: Unscoped repair creates unrelated behavior.

lessons.rule: Preserve owner work, use a clean worktree, query Graphify before broad search, follow Ponytail minimum diff, and use one direct Codex. Diff is not progress; encode durable learning here, in a contract, or test.
lessons.why: Parallel workflow authorities waste context and obscure responsibility.

lessons.rule: Agent prose is a report, not proof; verify head, diff, CI, deployment, and required read-only facts independently.
lessons.why: Claims do not change repository or production state.

lessons.rule: An empty UI is not proof of missing schema; inspect the reader, API, and current schema first.
lessons.why: Reader failures and ownership errors are common alternatives.

lessons.rule: Unknown historical optional facts remain NULL unless authoritative evidence explicitly supports backfill.
lessons.why: Missing evidence is not a value.

lessons.rule: Optional metrics or derived data cannot suppress valid authoritative history.
lessons.why: A secondary failure must not hide confirmed business work.

lessons.rule: Keep exact prior serialized compatibility; add new fields through a versioned/new path rather than weakening legacy fallback.
lessons.why: Loose fallback silently corrupts durable recovery.

lessons.rule: A structural import-template change increments its format contract and fails with an explicit upgrade message.
lessons.why: Workbook layouts are executable interfaces.

lessons.rule: Import confirmation revalidates the resolved execution plan/hash, not only raw workbook cells.
lessons.why: Preview and commit are separate authority phases.

lessons.rule: Committed counts and checkpoints are historical evidence only; current production claims need fresh read-only evidence.
lessons.why: Repository history cannot observe deployed state.

lessons.rule: If Graphify is unavailable use targeted search; if Ponytail hooks fail the root minimum-change policy remains active. Do not install infrastructure or rebuild a controller to continue delivery.
lessons.why: Tools are assistance, not authority.

lessons.rule: Do not ask a live coding-agent controller to rewrite its own execution engine; CRM has no coding-agent controller.
lessons.why: Self-hosted orchestration obscures verification.

lessons.rule: Inspect relevant callers and prefer one correct shared-boundary repair over sibling patches.
lessons.why: Repeated local patches preserve the root defect.

lessons.rule: Call a failure pre-existing only when the same command fails on clean current main.
lessons.why: A branch is not baseline evidence.
